body.name: Block-stable fixed-rank panel class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_n=\{P_n:P_n\text{ obeys every member property listed in }\texttt{by-member-properties}\}\), with the triangular-array index \(n\), all dimensions, and all fixed constants governed by those displayed properties.  No equality with, or additional restriction inherited from, any bibliographically cited comparison class is part of this definition.
